_doc: Same keys as bhb.overrides.json. The clean source (2021 printing) already leaves out the songs owned by other publishers (e.g. 184 How Deep the Father's Love, 236 In Christ Alone, 420 How Great Thou Art, 162, 133, 343); their rights holders are listed in bible-data/licenses/hymnals/nbhb.md. The Remembrance Hymns by Isaac Y. Ewan are marked third_party by the rightsRules in nbhb.meta.json.

notes: The fifth line of each verse is sung three times.
